items.text: Release agents use the fast allocator, and session output is framed once instead of copied twice.
The session agent copies pane output into its rings in two block moves instead of one byte at a time.
The session agent rewrites a pane's reboot history every 5 minutes instead of every 30 seconds, and a restore keeps an older history plus the output after it.
Busy panes no longer take turns in the session agent: each session parses its own output off the agent-wide lock.
An idle session holder sleeps until its shell exits instead of checking five times a second.
